name: SatNet LEO Group 29
location_str: Commercial LC-2 @ Wenchang Space Launch Site, CHN
destination_explanation: Most of the satellites working today are down here, which has made this by far the most crowded stretch of space around the planet.
slot_a_text: A batch of 9 Low Earth Orbit communication satellites for the Chinese state owned SatNet constellation operated by the China Satellite Network Group. The constellation will eventually consists of 13000 satellites.
slot_b_text: Long March 12 is designed to lift at least 10 tonnes to Low Earth Orbit.
